pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASSES: CONJUNCTIONS – BECAUSE, THAT, WHEN, IF, UNLES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we join sentences correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words
2. use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles.
4. Show that you can: identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Work with peers to read a text,
2. Fill in blanks in sentences using the listed conjunctions individually,
3. Make sentences using the listed conjunctions,
4. Collaborate to create dialogues using the listed conjunctions,
5. Collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner recites poems with peers.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we join sentences correctly?
2. Why do we use conjunctions?
3. How can one join two or more sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words
2. use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
